title: PROP & DRIVE SHAFTS, DIFF. CARRIER & SPINDLE ARM
summary: Rear driveline: the propeller shaft (driveshaft) from the transmission to the differential, the axle drive shafts (half shafts) from the differential to the rear spindle support arms (trailing arms, with brakes), the differential carrier (rear end / 'pumpkin') and the caution sticker on the jack storage compartment cover. The prop shaft and the half shafts' inner U-joints are held to their yokes by U-bolts, lock washers and nuts; each half shaft's outer flange bolts to the spindle with bolts locked by bend-over lock tabs.

fastening.note: View A: bolts [2] fasten the outer U-joint flange of the half shaft [3] to the spindle; lock [1] under the bolt heads. View B: bend one tab tight against a flat on the bolt head.

Rear U-joint of prop shaft [11] strapped to the pinion yoke of the differential [7] with U-bolts [8], lock washers [9] and nuts [10]. Align paint marks on the shaft and yoke.
Caution sticker [13] glued to the cover beside the auto jack instruction sticker (see UPC 14).
